buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Provisions for workmen compensation, insurance, public liability, property damage, insurance etc. to be ensured by the contractor. Also, safety measures prescribed for working in Extra High Voltage & use of personnel protective equipment must be adhered to. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses QUALIFYING REQUIREMENTS: ARC for maintenance of 6.6KV switchgears, LT Transformers, Panels of DG sets, 1860KWp Solar System, EOT Cranes & Hoists installed at PPS-III, Bawana. A. TECHNICAL CAPABILITIES: 1) The bidder should have experience of having successfully completed the works of Erection & Commissioning/AMC /Overhauling contracts of HT & LT Electrical system in SEBs/ IPGCL-PPCL /NTPC/Govt. PSUs/Semi Govt. PSUs/DTL/ Reputed Power Stations with an experience of at least three fields of following specialized areas: a) 6.6KV or above switchgears. b) LT Transformers of 6.6KV or above. c) LT Control/power panels of ECP, T & AVT panel or panels of DG sets or EOT Crane & Hoist etc. d) Electrical Maintenance of Rooftop Solar Plant. 2) The bidder should have valid electrical contractor license.

B. FINANCIAL CAPABILITIES: Average annual financial turnover during the last 3 years, ending 31st March of the previous financial year, should be at least 30% of the annualized estimated cost i.e. Rs. 7.85 Lakh. During last 5 years ending last day of month previous to the one in which applications are invited should be either of the following:- � Three similar completed works costing not less than the amount equal to 40% of the annualized estimated cost i.e. Rs. 10.47 Lakh. OR � Two similar completed works costing not less than the amount equal to 50% of the annualized estimated cost i.e. Rs. 13.09 Lakh. OR � One similar completed works costing not less than the amount equal to 80% of the annualized estimated cost i.e. Rs. 20.94 Lakh SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS Subject: ARC for maintenance of 6.6 kv switchgears, LT Transformers, panels of DG sets, 1860KW Solar Sy stem, EOT cranes & hoists etc installed at PPS-III, Bawana. A. General: 1. The vendor/ contractor shall have to quote their rate keeping in mind the total nos. of manpower includi ng their educational qualification and experiences. 2. Contractor/bidder shall have working experience of 6.6KV switchgears, 6.6KV/415V LT transformers, LT s witchgears, Electrical Maintenance of Solar System, EOT Cranes/hoists etc. The Bidders should furnish the details of their work experience of past similar works along with satisfactory completion and performance certificates. 3. The Contractor’s manpower shall execute work at one or more locations simultaneously, whenever requ ired by PPCL, without any additional financial implication to PPCL. 4. The contractor must possess the valid Electrical Contractor license, Labour License, EPF and ESI Registr ation Certificate and shall be uploaded on GeM at the time of bidding. 5. The Bidder shall submit an undertaking confirming compliance with Regulation-7 read with Schedule-II o f Central Electricity Authority (Measures Relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations, 2010 and ame ndments thereof. 6. Service & Support: The vendor must have Dedicated Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. Contractor will satisfy himself with the details of the work to be executed and if considered necessary th ey should visit the site and get any other information required in this connection. 8. The Contractor shall be deemed to have fully acquainted himself with the site conditions, nature of work , accessibility constraints, safety requirements and operational conditions before submission of the bid. 9. The contractor/ supervisor shall maintain daily work register at site. 10. Work is to be started only after taking the instructions/PTW from PPCL Maintenance Engineer / PPCL sit e Engineer. 11. Any incidental expenses in form of transport/material handling etc. will be in contractor’s account. 12. The Contractor shall provide the Uniforms for their staff while working in plant area along with safety s hoes, helmets etc.

13. Attending the complete fault after isolation of the equipment OR without isolation in case of control cir cuit fault is the responsibility of the contractor and his staff. Hence, the contractor shall make the necessar y arrangements to depute the well qualified staff, so that they should be able to attend all types of faults i n the system. 14. In view to avoid complications, overall guarantee of the work / works done, nature of work and urgenc y for completion of work, the complete Scope of work should be awarded to a single party / bidder. The co ntract shall be awarded on the basis of overall merit of all the items to a single party. B. Mobilization: 1- Regarding preventive maintenance works, contractor/supervisor/electrician will be informed at least Eig ht hours in advance. 2- The contractor shall mobilize the manpower at the work place within 1 hour, in case of emergency / brea kdown conditions need on round the clock basis. 3- The contractor shall have to mention their contact mobile nos. so that intimation of work may be conve yed in time. 4- The work shall be carried out in accordance with the detailed Scope of Work attached, which shall form an integral part of this tender document. 5- The Contractor shall provide qualified manpower, supervision, tools, tackles and associated resources n ecessary for satisfactory execution of the work covered under Scope of Work and as directed by the Engine er-in-Charge (EIC). 6- The Contractor’s manpower shall execute work at one or more locations simultaneously, whenever requ ired by PPCL, without any additional financial implication to PPCL. 7- The Contractor shall be deemed to have fully acquainted himself with the site conditions, nature of work , accessibility constraints, safety requirements and operational conditions before submission of the bid. 8- Working shifts (includes day and night shift) if any, and daily working hours shall be mutually agreed up on between PPCL and the vendor and should follow all the labor laws. C- Penalty: 1. In case the contractor fails to attend the faults/breakdowns during prescribed time, then a penalty @ Rs. 500.00 per day shall be deducted from the contractor's invoice. 2. Delay in wage payment: 1% per week subject to maximum 5%. 3. Failure to mobilize manpower, attend breakdowns or execute assigned work shall invite Risk & Cost acti on. D. Payment: 1. Contractor must ensure the payment of monthly salary along with bonus to their staff under the contrac t till 7th of the every month. 2. The contractor shall submit the bill for their staffs deputed against contract on bi-monthly (at every two months) basis in the office of the Manager (T) Elect-2, PPS-III, Bawana along with all supporting documents as Bank statement, EPF, ESI, copy of wage register etc which show payment of Salary, bonus, EPF, ESI etc. The payment shall be done as per terms and condition of NIT. 3. Contractor should ensure payment of notified latest minimum wages to his workers and compliance of a ll other applicable labour laws and maintenance of statutory records in respect of his workers. Apart from t he above compliances should ensure payment of bonus to his workers under Payment of Bonus Act, 1965, if Act is applicable. 4. Wages to be paid by electronic transfer into the account of contractual workmen by vendor. Contractor shall submit the copy last month bank statement of worker engaged by contractor for the execution of wor k, showing the credit of last month salary 5. Contractor shall fulfill the all statutory requirement as per the labour laws defined by Govt. of NCT of Del hi in reference to the wages, safety etc to their workmen.

E. Statutory & Safety Rules: 1. To ensure implementation of all statutory precautions required for safety is contractor’s responsibility. 2. It is imperative for contractor to provide constant supervision while carrying out work in accordance with provisions of Indian Electricity Act. 1956. 3. Contractor shall ensure that all the supervisors & labours employed shall works as per Delhi factory rule s & regulations including minimum wage law. Also to maintain all the register & forms as per factory act. 4. The deputed staff shall be covered under Provident Fund, Insurance, and workman compensation act. In case of any accident during the period of contract, the contractor shall be liable for any injury to its staff & PPCL shall not have any liability on this account. 5. The contractor shall be solely responsible and shall ensure due compliance with all the legal requiremen t concerning the workman employed by him under the provisions of applicable labour and other legislation s. In the event of the contractor committing any fault resulting in PPCL being required to insure any liability or expenses or PPCL being required to any notice/summons in this respect the same shall be entitl ed to recover from the contractor liability attached to it due to any proceedings. 6. The contractor shall accept all risks of stoppage of hindrances to his work by outside interferences. Cont ractor shall take necessary steps to ensure that all the electrical installations of the PPCL and other service s like water connections pipe lines, sewer pipelines, open drains, telephone cables, etc. are not damaged b y his workers in anyway. Contractor will be responsible for all such damages and shall have to repair of failing which he has to pay entire cost of damages. In case of damages to PPCL, pro perty/material contractor has to pay replacement cost 7. The contractor shall make all the arrangements for the safety of his staff. The PPCL shall not be responsi ble in any way for injury/disablement, accident to any workman on this account and will be free from any l egal bindings in this regard. PPCL will not be responsible to pay any damage to the workman of the contra ctor or any outside agencies. Contractor must ensure proper safety for his workers. Work-force working on site must wear safety helmets/proper shoes/goggles/gloves etc. 8. The work is to be carried out in the presence of authorized supervisor (skilled) having adequate knowled ge. 9. The contractor shall confirm to all the labour laws governing the workmen engaged by them directly or t hrough sub-contractor and implement the provision of the factories Act, compensation Act & other Acts & Rules & regulations framed there under & also provision of any other act as may be applicable for operatio n or carrying out the said contract. 10. PTW for any work requiring shutdown will be taken by PPCL. Contractor will start work only after neces sary PTW is issued. 11. Before carrying out the work, it shall be entire responsibility of the contractor to take all the safety pre cautions and shut downs etc. if required during the execution of work. All shut downs / PTW will be taken b y PPCL Engineers. F. Tools & Tackles: Following items are of general in nature and are to be arranged by the contractor at his own cost: 1. All requisite T&P, safety equipments, PPE etc 2. All regular/ routine measuring and testing instrument required for execution of work. G. Following will be in the scope of PPCL (free of cost): 1. Electricity & water 2. Space for site office / store depending upon the availability. H. Contract Period:- Time period of the work will be 01 (One) Year from date of start of work. Period of cont ract may be extended for further Six Months with mutual consent subject to satisfactory performance verif ied by Engineer-in-charge of execution wing. The contactor is required to attend the work within stipulated time notice/intimation from the site in charge through Fax/e-mail/telephone or in person, in case non- com pliance of this clause, the work shall be got carried out at the risk & cost of contactor beside deduction of L iquidated Damages.

I. Manpower: 1. Required minimum Manpower: For timely execution of the work, the contractor will ensure the availability of minimum manpower on daily basis as per below and shall deploy additional manpower as pe r site requirement. a) Supervisor-1, Skilled-2, Semi skilled-4 2. Supervisors deployed for the maintenance of electrical job should have minimum qualification of Degree /Diploma in Electrical and should have minimum experience of 02/05 years respectively in the field of mai ntenance of electrical equipments of power station, as mentioned in the Scope of Work. 3. Skilled Electrician deployed for electrical maintenance of the Pragati Power Station III should have minim um qualification of Diploma/ITI with minimum 01/02 years of relevant work experience in the field of maint enance of electrical equipments of power station, as mentioned in the Scope of Work. 4. Semi-Skilled Electrician deployed for electrical maintenance of the Pragati Power Station III should have relevant work experience in the field of maintenance of electrical equipments of power station, as mention ed in the Scope of Work. 5. The Contractor shall maintain minimum manpower (as detailed above) deployment throughout the cont ract period. 6. PPCL may seek replacement of unsuitable manpower and the Contractor shall provide replacement with in 24 hours. 7. Contractor personnel shall remain employees of the Contractor only and shall have no claim whatsoever against PPCL regarding employment, regularization, wages, compensation, absorption, service benefits or any other employment-related matter. PPCL shall have no employer-employee relationship with the perso nnel deployed by the Contractor. 8. The contractor shall maintain a work order/complaint register at site to get instructions from Engineer in charge on daily basis. 9. No TA/DA shall be payable to the vendor. No Casual Leave shall be entitled to the deputed manpower of the vendor. J. Liability for Accident & Damages: The bidder shall be responsible for any loss/damages due to accident o f deputed staffs/manpower at site. K. Insurance: The bidder at his own expense shall carry out & maintain insurance cover like the workmen c ompensation and shall also indemnify and hold Purchaser harmless from liabilities whatsoever on this acc ount. The bidder shall ensure compliance of all statutory and mandatory requirements including all labour l aws requirements. L. Workmen’s Compensation Insurance: The insurance shall protect the contract against all claims applica ble under the Govt. of India Workmen’s Compensation Act, 1948. This policy shall also cover the bidder ag ainst claims for injury, disability, disease or death of his or his sub-bidder’s employees, which for any reaso ns are not covered under the workmen’s compensation act 1948. The liabilities shall not be less than: Wor kmen’s Compensation – As per statutory provisions. Employee’s liability – As per statutory provisions. The i nsurance cover may be taken with the Indian companies. M. Safety Measures: The bidder shall have to provide all safety needs as per the requirements and as felt n ecessary by the Engineer for safety of the bidder’s workers/staff. Use of matchbox, lighters & smoking or o ther such acts, which may cause fire, are strictly prohibited. In the plant unit room no hot works such as w elding, gas cutting etc. which may cause fire shall be carried out until & unless requisite fire extinguishers are arranged at the location & shall be carried out until & unless the same is co-ordinate with security staff & fire wing at the Substation if asked for. N. Safety: The agency shall be responsible for safety of all workmen employed by it from time to time and it shall be responsible for payment of any compensation that may arise out of any accident, injury or death of workers during the execution of contract. IPGCL-PPCL shall bear no liability whatsoever towards any viol ations by the agency in this regard. The agency shall be responsible for the safe execution of work adoptin g safe work procedures. O. Contract Agreement & Indemnity Bond: The successful bidder shall submit the following documents on non-judicial stamp papers in the prescribed PPCL format before commencement of work:

(a) Contract Agreement on Rs.100/- Non-Judicial Stamp Paper. (b) Indemnity Bond on Rs.10/- Non-Judicial Stamp Paper. The cost of stamp papers and execution of documents shall be borne by the Contractor. P. Labour Law Compliance (i) The Contractor shall comply with: a) Minimum Wages Act. b) EPF Act. c) ESI Act. d) Bonus Act. e) Contract Labour Act. f) Workmen Compensa tion Act. g) Any other applicable statutory provisions. (ii) Wherever ESI coverage is not applicable under the relevant statutory provisions, the Contractor shall ar range and maintain a Health Insurance Policy with a minimum coverage of Rs.5,00,000/- (Rupees Five Lak h only) per worker/family for all personnel deployed under the contract. Documentary evidence of such ins urance shall be submitted to PPCL whenever demanded by PPCL. Q. Web site compliance: The contractor shall maintain a valid official website showing all the details of the workman as per govt. of Delhi and constant up gradation/updation of the website as per Govt. of Delhi. R. Miscellaneous: 1. Contractor shall comply with Factory Act provisions, plant safety rules and statutory safety regulations. 2. PPCL reserves the right to execute work through other agencies at the risk and cost of contractor in case of non performance. 3. All other terms and conditions shall be governed by the provisions of the PPCL NIT. II). EMD SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS TO BIDDERS: 1. The exemption from Earnest Money deposit (EMD) shall be extended only to those MSME vendors who are registered under the Service/Manufacturer/Trader Category as Micro or S mall Enterprises (MSEs) and whose Udyam Registration covers the relevant product/activity as per tender’s scope of work. 2. EMD may be furnished, details of which uploaded on web site, in any of the followi ng forms. (a) Demand Draft in favour of PPCL. (b) Bank Guarantee from a Nationalized Bank/scheduled bank irrevocable and oper ative till the validity of the offer as per standard Proforma. (c) Bankers Cheque. (d) ECS in favour of PPCL , New Delhi TENDER SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS TO BIDDERS: 1. The bidder shall submit all required documents as per the Qualifying Requirements ( QR) specified in the NIT. 2. Scanned copies of execution/completion certificates indicating the executed amount against the respective work orders must be submitted. 3. Completion certificates shall clearly mention the work order number & date, order va lue, executed value, period of execution (start & completion date) and Performance during the contractual period. 4. Details of the EMD shall be clearly mentioned on the face of the EMD envelope, whic h must be submitted on or before the bid submission end date and time. 5. The bidder must possess valid registration with EPF and ESI authorities and shall sub mit self-attested copies of these certificates, duly stamped and signed, along with t he techno-commercial bid. 6. An undertaking on the company’s letterhead shall be submitted certifying that the fir m is not blacklisted or debarred by any Government, Semi-Government, Board, or C orporate/Private Organization. 7. An undertaking on the company’s letterhead shall be submitted confirming acceptan ce of the scope of work and all terms and conditions of the tender. 8. An undertaking on the company’s letterhead shall be submitted certifying that origin al certificates will be produced for verification of the submitted copies, if required.

9. The bid shall be submitted in two parts (Techno-Commercial & Price Bid). Prices mus t not be mentioned anywhere in the Technical Bid, otherwise the bid shall be summ arily rejected. 10. The bidder shall ensure that only relevant documents, as required in the NIT, are u ploaded with the bid. 11. The exemption from Earnest Money deposit (EMD) shall be extended only to t hose MSME vendors who are registered under the Service/Manufacturer/Trade r Category as Micro or Small Enterprises (MSEs) and whose Udyam Registratio n covers the relevant product/activity as per tender’s scope of work 12. INSTRUCTIONS REGARDING COMMON IP ADDRESS: Bidders are advised to note that if any bid is found to have a matching or common IP address with any other bidder on the Delhi Government e-Port al, all such bids shall be outrightly rejected without any further communi cation and will not be considered for further evaluation. 12. If you have any query please contact following number:- I. Manoj Kr. Tripathi, Sr. Manager (CS-II) Mob No.9717698215, E-mail ID: mktripathi2000@yahoo.co.in II. P. C .Bhatt, Manager (Tech) Mob: 9717708774, E-mail ID:d mcsipgcl@gmail.com Special Note: The bidder shall quote only the percentage (+/–) above or below the total BOQ value. The quoted percentage shall be uniformly applicable to all activities/items of the BOQ. Any change in individual unit rates shall not be permitted and, if quoted, the bid shall be liable for outright rejection/necessary acti on. So please fill only Company/firm name and percentage (+/–) above or below tab in BOQ. . 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
